name: Accordion
title: Accordion
summary: The FAQ accordion: rounded, bordered rows built on native `<details>`/`<summary>` that open in place with a plus that turns to a cross.
whenToUse: Use for FAQs and other sets of short, independent answers people scan by question.
Use on the FAQ page, at the foot of product pages (dot.Bible app, NFC cards, HD Radio) and in giving help.
whenNotToUse: Do not hide content everyone needs (prices, key steps, legal terms people must read); show it.
Do not nest accordions or put forms inside one.

anatomy.description: The row styles (`.acc`, `details`, `summary`, `.ans`) come from the base layer; `.dp-acc-panel` adds the optional `--gray-100` panel.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled list of open item ids. Several rows may be open at once.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open ids. Open the first row by default on the FAQ page only; elsewhere start all closed.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the open ids when a row opens or closes.

props.name: panel
props.description: Place the rows on the `--gray-100` panel. Drop it to sit straight on the page.

variantNotes: Closed: white row, `--border-hairline-light` border, `--radius-ml` corners, 30px circular plus on the right.
Open: border turns to 45% Horizon Blue, the plus rotates 45° into a cross, answer shows below in `--gray-700` 16px.
Hover: pointer cursor on the summary; no colour change.
Focus: `summary:focus-visible` gets the Horizon Blue outline and `--shadow-focus`.
Panel: `.dp-acc-panel` places the rows on a `--gray-100` card with `--radius-lg` and 24px padding.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: The caret/plus means "opens here". Never use ↗ or › on an accordion row.
Open the first item by default on the FAQ page only; elsewhere start all closed.
Several rows may be open at once; do not force exclusive opening.
Keep 12px between rows (`.acc` gap). Summary row is at least 44px tall.
Put links inside answers in `--horizon-blue`; links to another page end in ↗.
Do not add icons or numbers before the question.
do: Use for FAQs and other sets of short, independent answers people scan by question.
Use on the FAQ page, at the foot of product pages (dot.Bible app, NFC cards, HD Radio) and in giving help.

dont: Do not hide content everyone needs (prices, key steps, legal terms people must read); show it.

accessibility: Native `<details>`/`<summary>` give keyboard and screen-reader support for free: Enter/Space toggles, state is announced.
Do not replace `summary` with a `div` or add `role="button"`.
Write questions as full questions so they make sense out of context in a screen-reader list.
Respect reduced motion: the base layer turns off the plus rotation transition.
content: Questions in the reader's words, ending with "?": "Are your Bible apps free?"
Answers start with the answer ("Yes.", "No.", "Within 5 days.") then one or two plain sentences.
Keep each answer under about 60 words; link out for more.

html:
What does ISM do?

We make scripture accessible through apps, radio, publishing and NFC share cards.

Are your Bible apps free?

Yes. Every app in the dot.Bible directory is free to download.
